messages.content: A local maritime museum sent my food-travel channel a note saying they would love to "bring the harbor's stories to life" with me. They say they can arrange a visit and hope we can cross-promote, but they have not described a project or asked for anything specific.

A language-learning app wants me to make three short videos demonstrating its new pronunciation feature. They say I will be paid "once the campaign performs" and mention a 10% share, but have not explained what the share is calculated from or what performance threshold triggers payment. They want the videos posted within four weeks.

{"project_type":"Creator sponsorship campaign","requirements":["Create three short videos demonstrating the app's pronunciation feature","Compensation is described as a 10% share after campaign performance","Post within four weeks"],"deliverables":["Three short videos demonstrating the pronunciation feature"],"budget":"10% share proposed; calculation basis, performance threshold and payout terms unspecified","timeline":"Within four weeks; exact posting dates unspecified","revision_limit":null,"missing_information":["What the 10% share applies to and how performance is measured","Threshold or event that triggers payment","Reporting, attribution and payout schedule","Any guaranteed minimum fee","Video length, platforms and product access","Content usage and approval terms"],"assumptions":[],"clarifying_questions":["Ten percent of which amount or revenue, and what counts as campaign performance?","Is there a minimum performance threshold before any payment is due?","How will results be reported and when will the creator be paid?","Is any guaranteed fee offered in addition to the performance share?","Which platforms and video lengths should be used, and what usage rights does the app need?"]}

A cycling app is offering me $1,200 for an honest review video and wants to run it as a partnership ad from my creator account. Their agency also asked for my account login so they can set up the campaign. The brief does not say how long the ad may run or whether I can revoke access after the campaign.

{"project_type":"Sponsored product review and partnership ad","requirements":["Create an honest review video for a cycling app","App offers $1,200","Agency proposes running the video as a partnership ad from the creator's account","Agency requests the creator's account login"],"deliverables":["One review video; length and platform unspecified"],"budget":"$1,200 offered; payment terms unconfirmed","timeline":null,"revision_limit":null,"missing_information":["Video platform, length and publication deadline","Whether the creator accepts the offer","Ad duration, targeting and permitted edits","Safe authorization method and revocation process","Approval process and any category exclusivity"],"assumptions":[],"clarifying_questions":["Which platform, video length and deadline are expected?","Do you accept the $1,200 offer, and when would payment be made?","How long may the partnership ad run, and what targeting or edits are permitted?","Can the agency use the platform's official partner authorization instead of receiving your password, and how can access be revoked?","Is there an approval or exclusivity requirement?"]}

We're a community theater looking for a creator to help our winter production reach younger audiences. We can pay $700, and we'd like to start promoting in January. We have not decided whether this means a behind-the-scenes feature, a cast interview, ticket giveaways, or something else.

{"project_type":"Community theater creator partnership","requirements":["Promote the theater's winter production to younger audiences","Theater offers $700","Promotion is expected to begin in January","Specific content has not been selected"],"deliverables":[],"budget":"$700 offered; payment timing and scope not confirmed","timeline":"Promotion to begin in January; exact dates unspecified","revision_limit":null,"missing_information":["Chosen content format and number of deliverables","Target platforms and audience definition","Production dates and access for filming or interviews","Ticket-giveaway terms, if applicable","Required talking points, approvals and usage rights"],"assumptions":[],"clarifying_questions":["Which content format do you want, and how many pieces should be created?","Which platforms and age group are you trying to reach?","When can filming or cast interviews happen?","If you want a ticket giveaway, how many tickets and what entry rules should apply?","When will the $700 be paid, and does the theater need approval or reuse rights?"]}

A conference organizer wants me to host a 90-minute livestream, interview four speakers, create speaker quote graphics, and send edited recordings to every speaker. The conference starts in 36 hours. They say the livestream link and speaker names will arrive after I confirm, and have not mentioned compensation.
